high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "Kubera," directed by Sekhar Kammula. The poster features a man sitting on a stone bench outdoors, with a serene and contemplative mood. He is dressed in a dark blue shirt and light-colored pants, and he has a watch on his left wrist. His right hand is raised in a waving gesture, suggesting a friendly or welcoming demeanor. The background shows a blurred view of what appears to be a garden or courtyard with some greenery and a structure that could be part of a building. The lighting is soft and natural, indicating it might be daytime.
